report:
Independently reassessed the complete kind_wrappers claim and its entire associated set: the ordinary sage_ir::symbol implementation and sole TODO test sage_meta::todo::symbols_kind_wrappers. Verified current implementation file and representation_spec.rs are exact byte matches to the historical input; the prior rationale remains appropriate, but this is a fresh source assessment.

The claim requires heterogeneous membership/resolution values, kind-specific operation receivers, identity-preserving conversion to Symbol, successful matching-kind recovery and failure for a different kind. define_kind_symbols creates the heterogeneous private/public data enums and local/external kind wrappers; From conversions retain the underlying handle. Symbol::children and module enumeration expose heterogeneous Symbol collections. ModSymbol::expanded_module_items, EnumSymbol::variants, TraitSymbol::sig/items, FnSymbol::sig and MacroDefSymbol::expand demonstrate kind-specific receivers and local/external dispatch. Symbol::module and trait_symbol return Some only for matching represented variants and None for others. These are source examples, not proof of complete kind coverage. Unsupported external data dispatch still has an explicit todo arm; macro-generated external From conversions are unchecked construction, not evidence of checked recovery. The abstract location-only module is not executable dispatch.

The sole associated test has an empty body and explicitly defers complete compile-time/API conversion and local/external dispatch coverage for every supported kind. It contains no behavioral assertions and would not detect wrong-kind acceptance or identity loss. This existing deferral adequately reserves the missing complete conversion/API and dispatch matrix, including heterogeneous results, matching recovery and wrong-kind rejection; it is not counted as implemented or tested behavior. Prerequisites for closing it are complete supported-kind recovery/dispatch APIs and local/external fixtures plus compile-time/API checks and runtime identity, matching-kind and mismatched-kind assertions for each supported kind (including local-only kinds). No unassociated tests or helper implementation internals are credited.

Execution: personally ran review start, review read for the review contract, and an exact-byte baseline comparison. No behavior tests or build were run by this reviewer and no source was edited. Coordinator-reported passing build and 321 sage-meta tests are separate execution context, not evidence that this deferred claim is tested. All aspects remain accounted for by inspected examples and explicit TODO evidence; no additional edits requested.
